newsitem.title: JAPAN: TEPCO to build 3,300-kw geothermal plant in Japan.
newsitem.headline: TEPCO to build 3,300-kw geothermal plant in Japan.

text.p: Tokyo Electric Power Co Inc (TEPCO) said on Thursday that it would build a 3,300 kilowatt (kw) geothermal power plant on Hachijo Island, south of Tokyo.
Construction of the geothermal plant, TEPCO's first, will begin next January and it is due to begin operating in March 1999.
Japan is rich in clean geothermal resources.
Hailed as one of Japan's few domestic energy sources, geothermal power is free from nitrogen oxide emissions which accompany the use of fossil fuels.
